items.text: Distinguish order accepted, working, partial fill, cancelled, rejected, missed, timed out and unknown outcome; never synthesize missing fills.
evidence: The append-only order journal now distinguishes CREATED, SUBMITTED, ACCEPTED, WORKING, PARTIAL, FILLED, CANCEL_PENDING, CANCELED, REJECTED, MISSED, TIMED_OUT, UNKNOWN and EXPIRED with explicit legal transitions, including fills that race a cancel request.

The ForwardSessionRunner persists order events in the same SQLite journal as its durable outbox and paper receipts. Intents record CREATED/SUBMITTED; successful receipts record PARTIAL/FILLED/MISSED/REJECTED; a durable outbox exception or restart records UNKNOWN. Session records return the canonical per-order event trace.

Resume reconstructs a missing terminal event only from an already DISPATCHED outbox and its hashed durable receipt. It never turns a PENDING/UNKNOWN key into a fill; receipt-based effect reconciliation or explicit no-effect reconciliation is required first.

Cumulative fill quantity cannot increase outside PARTIAL/FILLED; every increase requires an immutable SHA-256 fill-evidence ID and positive price. UNKNOWN/TIMED_OUT quantities are not counted as known. Complete session close is blocked while an order remains PARTIAL/WORKING/UNKNOWN or otherwise unresolved.

The read-only blotter marks accepted/working/cancel-pending/partial/timeout/unknown orders unresolved and hides fill quantity where outcome is ambiguous. Cash PaperAccount, options ledger and legacy intraday OMS adapters retain separate state models.

Test power loss at signal, approval, cash reserve, funds-receipt, NAV notice, allotment, redemption and payout; replay must be idempotent.
Test duplicate network events and corrections; one economic event can only post once to the ledger.
Test disabled real broker endpoints through every old and new OMS path, including malicious/accidental mode switches.
Test stress cases: 25% stock/ETF gap, 50% option premium loss, MF gated redemption, stale NAV, illiquid quote, simultaneous correlated exposure.
Run Linux + Windows full CI, minimum critical-module coverage, API contract tests, mutation/property tests and a timed market-hours failure rehearsal.

Validate permitted ETF market data, contract quotes and AMFI history from genuine sources (**EXTERNAL**).
Check live Kite access, quote throughput/limits and options-chain quote entitlement; do not hardcode assumptions (**EXTERNAL**).
Obtain actual MF order platform integration or reliable fund confirmation feed only if later enabling live mutual fund subscriptions (**EXTERNAL**).
Implement real broker and exchange controls only after separate account, approval, compliance, kill-switch and operational rehearsals (**EXTERNAL**).
Run independently observed paper sessions across representative regimes; cannot simulate elapsed future evidence (**EXTERNAL time**).
Add automatic artifact backups and restore verification for DuckDB journals, NAV and quote archives and model versions.
Document source quotas, rights, licensing, retention and failover; reject a feed when its intended use is not authorized.
Publish capability matrix: `IN_HOUSE_IMPLEMENTED`, `FIXTURE_TESTED`, `REAL_FEED_EVIDENCED`, `FORWARD_VALIDATED`, `LIVE_APPROVED`, with independent proof per desk.

Reject NaN, unavailable/negative-liquidity and optimistic missing-cost inputs.

Compute SL/TP hit probabilities, time-exit probabilities, gap risk and partial-exit effects using pre-decision information only; reject naive `reward:risk = 2:1` as sufficient evidence for positive expected value.

Add strategy/desk minimum trade hurdles: expected *net* return > costs + uncertainty buffer, liquidity/size feasibility, eligible session, accepted instrument and available budget. Parameter changes require a new frozen cohort.

Implement the explicit `TRADE / WATCH / REJECT / CASH` decision with reason-coded outcomes (no edge, stale feed, confidence too low, marginal portfolio harm, cost, volatility, approvals, halted instrument).
Add executable signal price constraints: entry limit/zone, max spread, max gap/slippage and signal TTL. An expired signal needs a newly evaluated decision, never a late paper fill.
Produce a `trade_economics` receipt at decision time including gross scenario, brokerage/taxes/charges model version, risk-at-SL in INR, net TP, break-even and opportunity-cost comparison with cash.
Version and validate probabilistic forecasts with Brier/log loss, reliability diagrams and out-of-time calibration; explicitly label unreliable low-sample buckets as uncalibrated.
Add deterministic tests proving that attractive gross returns with insufficient net economic edge are skipped, while missing costs/quotes cannot default to a tradable outcome.

Introduce a central `CapitalAllocator` that grants/denies reserved risk budgets *before* each desk places a paper order; aggregate all equity, ETF, option and MF sleeves against one cash/settlement ledger.

Integrate existing `risk/allocator.py`, `portfolio/next_capital.py`, `portfolio/optimizer.py`, `portfolio/gate.py` under a single enforceable interface; test they cannot grant conflicting spending permissions.
Compute overlapping exposure by underlying/sector/index/factor: an equity BUY, NIFTY ETF, index call and equity MF cannot be treated as four independent diversifiers.
Combine delta-equivalent exposure and nonlinear option scenarios with ETF and MF available holding lookthrough; report uncovered/unavailable lookthrough rather than assuming zero risk.
Support limits by desk, strategy, underlying, market beta, sector, premium-at-risk, margin-at-risk, daily drawdown, overnight gap loss and scenario stress.
Use capacity- and uncertainty-aware capital assignment with cash as a valid optimal weight; prohibit reallocating to a loss-making strategy solely because it has a recent short-term win streak.
Implement configurable daily loss/portfolio drawdown throttling, desk-level quarantine and a human-reset kill switch; no autonomous increase in leverage to recover losses.
Write atomic allocation/hold/release transactions; stress-test concurrent swing/intraday/options signal bursts, MF pending redemptions and market restart for double spending.
Publish per-signal timing telemetry: source/exchange timestamp, local receipt, feature readiness, signal decision, OMS approval, simulated fill, risk stop and exit execution.
Replace latency-unsafe default polling on the instant-signal path with an asynchronous streamed adapter where permitted, while preserving a clearly labelled slower polling/replay fallback.
Enforce data-freshness and sequence checks by asset class and market phase; gaps, stale depth, dropped packets or reconnection trigger no-entry, reconciliation and explicit evidence-status downgrade.

Create a volume/depth-constrained fill simulator with spread crossing, partial fills, limit-order nonfills, marketable price walks, order TTL and cancel/replace; validate minute-bar approximations separately.

Estimate implementation shortfall by desk, liquidity bucket, order size, time of day and volatility; report realized simulation error versus market observations and never treat replay fills as actual fills.
Enforce no-lookahead stop/TP trigger ordering inside OHLC bars: ambiguous intrabar paths must use conservative bounds or be marked ambiguous; never choose the favorable ordering automatically.
Track tail latency, signal expiration rates, missed-trade frequency, false signal duplication and market-data coverage in dashboard and CI/golden scenario reports.
Implement executable event replay from immutable source data through exact same decision contract; test live/replay parity on a captured trace and precisely label remaining differences.
Implement one frozen `ExitPolicy` API for fixed SL/TP, ATR/volatility stop, trailing stop, staged profit-taking, time exits and strategy invalidation; version every policy tested.
Simulate paired stop-and-target exit intents with OCO semantics, ensuring one trigger cannot accidentally create two full exits or a reversed position.
Build `portfolio_exit_guard` to reduce exposure when aggregate desk risk, correlated losses or option Greeks breach limits, while respecting instrument execution mechanics.
Require all option exits to refer to exact active instrument tokens/contracts/legs; stop/TP on the underlying is a strategy trigger only, not a fabricated option premium fill.
Model overnight opening gaps and circuit limits for equities/ETFs, spread widening for options, and NAV-date/cash settlement delays for MF redemption triggers.
Evaluate partial fills, scale-outs, stop recalculation, option multi-leg close uncertainty and cancellation races without breaking cash/position invariants.
Benchmark exit variants prospectively against the frozen plain SL/TP baseline, with after-cost outcomes and multiple-comparison controls; do not optimize on the same forward trial being graded.
Save an independent linked closing `ExitSignal` for every executed exit, preserving actual trigger reason, trigger price, order intent, simulated fill price, fees and trade P&L.

Add options chain selection scoring on executable bid/ask, depth, open interest *with availability caveats*, IV, Greeks, theta decay, contract expiry, costs and premium-at-risk rather than underlying direction alone.
Build a constrained implied-volatility surface with quote quality checks, no-arbitrage diagnostics and time-consistent snapshots; never infer edge from an invalid/stale options quote.
Implement option strategy-level scenario P&L under underlying price, implied vol, time decay and spread shock, including defined-risk verticals and unfilled-leg contingency.
Add ETF executable fair-value comparison with iNAV/NAV freshness, exchange spread, trading size and tracking difference; apparent discount is not automatically accessible arbitrage.

Build ETF-vs-underlying-vs-competing-ETF routing for the same desired exposure: select the best *implementable net total return* after spread, depth, fee and tracking costs; preserve tax/account differences.

Build MF-vs-ETF-vs-direct equity exposure comparisons for long-term allocation using comparable TRI/category risk, available fund holdings, direct/regular plans, TER and applicable exit load/tax modeling.

Add MF tax-lot-aware switch/hold/redeem decisions, SIP/STP/SWP schedule evaluation, expected settlement cash-flow calendars and a downside policy that produces NAV-based redemption requests (not fictitious instantaneous SL fills).
Test option expiry, spread widening, stale ETF iNAV, ETF illiquidity, MF portfolio overlap, late funds realization and lot-level exit loads with deterministic adversarial fixtures.
Emit a daily consolidated report for each desk and strategy: opening NAV, cash flows, realized and unrealized P&L, fees, net return, closed/open positions and exposure.
Build a complete economic attribution: signal forecast error, market/sector/factor move, entry/exit timing, spread, impact, fees, financing/margin assumptions and unresolved/unpriced positions.
Distinguish cash-inflow-adjusted time-weighted returns, money-weighted/XIRR reporting, invested-capital returns and nominal rupee P&L; avoid claiming performance from contributions/SIPs.
Report per-desk profit factor, expectancy, median and tail loss, win rate, average winner/loser, drawdown, time-in-market, risk-adjusted return and matched benchmark net excess.
Produce a deterministic daily `why_profit_or_loss` report showing the top positive and negative economic drivers, with traceable observed inputs; do not let an LLM invent causes.
Compare autonomous vs trader-approved paper sleeves under the *same* decision-time quotes and fill rules; label human selection and execution effects separately.
Preserve rejected/expired/unfilled alternatives and their *counterfactual market outcomes* without crediting them as traded P&L; calculate selection regret with uncertainty.
Test total desk P&L = consolidated portfolio P&L after fee allocation, flows and rounding; reject any dashboard/report mismatch with the canonical ledger.

Extend the existing champion/challenger and protected trial infrastructure to require preregistered hypothesis, entry/exit rules, risk budget, target comparison, data cutoff and sample size *before* new paper cohorts are promoted.
Maintain a strategy registry with immutable semantic code/config hashes, features, cost version, active/paused/shadow status, capital permissions and independent desk ownership.
Compare each prospective strategy against cash, relevant instrument benchmark, cost-matched naive strategy and current champion; do not let momentum exposure masquerade as selection alpha.
Add dependent-return statistical methods (session-clustered and block-bootstrap uncertainty), confidence sequences where appropriate, and explicit multiple-testing adjustment across many candidates.

Calibrate forecast probabilities and expected return by market regime, asset, liquidity and confidence strata *only on prior data*, with sample-coverage reports and no adaptive use of protected test results.
Audit change of data vendor, latency class, order size, transaction cost or signal TTL as a material experiment version change; live-paper validation must be repeated when comparability breaks.
Enforce strategy retirement/degradation gates on forward drawdown, negative lower confidence bound, excessive shortfall, stale data and sample integrity; preserve full history of failed trials.

Produce evidence bundles with immutable signals, observed source timestamps, simulated execution receipts, strategy versions, portfolio NAV, trial registration, CI results and attestation state; never infer independent attestation from local hashes.
Build one searchable five-desk `Today` screen with prioritized BUY, SELL, WATCH, NO_TRADE, APPROVAL_NEEDED and EXIT_TRIGGERED messages, market/data freshness and outstanding risk.

Generate two-level alerts: informational opportunity cards and immediate *risk/exit* notices; include as-of time, time-to-expiry, decision deadline, rule version, evidence tier, SL/TP and position impact.
Support human approve/reject/adjust within declared guardrails for the manual paper sleeve; once signal TTL expires, reprice and revalidate instead of using the old approval.

Build an explainable post-market desk report: signals issued, trades eligible, signals missed, filled/exited positions, TP/SL reasons, P&L, fees, skipped opportunities, risk breaches and next-session obligations.
Provide a live health screen with market feed uptime, lag, quote gaps, queue backlog, ledger consistency, pending MF allotment/redemption, option expiry exposure and stale marks.
Enforce idempotent alerts, signals, orders, fills and exit triggers after crash/reconnect; no duplicated order, repeated profit recognition or silent orphan position.

Subscribe to current option contract ticks, bid/ask, visible quantities, OI, implied-vol inputs, expiry/strike/lot-size metadata, timestamps and source-quality flags; use the *actual tradable option's* depth for fills.

Define 3-class labels UP/DOWN/FLAT using training-period, index-specific price-noise thresholds; version thresholds; compute genuine option cost gates separately. Do not force a trade for a directional lean.

Build point-in-time features from prior 1m/5m/15m/60m returns, volatility, VWAP where meaningful, opening range, realized range, trend slope, overnight gap, time-of-day, session-to-expiry and market regime.

Write leak tests: mutate every event after forecast cutoff and assert no features/probabilities change; exclude unreleased revised observations, future index membership, future close/settlement prices or option quotes received after the decision.
Train naive frequency, no-change, price-persistence and volatility/time-of-day baseline classifiers for each index/horizon; benchmark before deep learning.

Train versioned, low-variance tree/logistic models on completed bars; test a shared multi-index model versus six index-specific models and hierarchical sector indexes without leaking information across time.
Generate `P_UP`, `P_DOWN`, `P_FLAT`, expected return in index points/bps, and prediction interval; ensure probabilities sum to 1 and model uncertainty is exposed, not just a confidence score.

Fit probabilities with held-out chronological calibration (e.g. isotonic or temperature calibrator) by market regime and time-of-day only when sufficient samples exist; report Brier/log loss, reliability bins and forecasting coverage.

Map each index forecast to CE, PE, defined-risk debit-spread or `NO_TRADE` candidates from *presently listed instruments*; require fresh bid/ask, lot size, displayed depth, expiry and contract eligibility. No synthetic option-chain contracts.

Rank option candidates by **expected executable net P&L**, downside tails, risk-adjusted expected value and portfolio marginal impact; compare to index/ETF alternatives and `NO_TRADE`.

Aggregate exposure across NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY, stocks and index ETFs; enforce underlying/beta/sector correlated risk limits, position caps and daily loss/drawdown kill switches. Prevent duplicated signal orders across refreshes.

Reconcile each index signal to `RESEARCH_ONLY`, `NO_TRADE`, `WATCH`, `PAPER_ELIGIBLE`, `UNFILLED`, `OPEN`, `PARTIALLY_EXITED`, `CLOSED` or `UNPRICED`; no ghost paper profits on missing option quotes or spreads.

Construct global date-wise and session-wise time splits with purging/embargo over overlapping 15m, 30m, 60m labels and cross-index features; use fixed out-of-sample windows and strictly as-of quote availability.

Backtest index direction and option profitability separately. Direction: balanced accuracy, Brier/log loss, calibration by index/regime/clock. Trading: net INR, NAV, expectancy, drawdown, turnover, fill coverage, regret, missed trades and options-specific tail exposure.

Schedule one event at completion of every eligible 15m interval (e.g. bar ending 09:30 → predict 09:30–09:45 IST), using exchange-aware calendars and checks for fully observed bars; keep 30m, 60m, EOD as separately labeled horizons.

Implement WebSocket reconnect, backfill-on-gap, clock skew checks, inference timeouts, circuit breakers, stale-data sentinel, and idempotent resume; emit `UNAVAILABLE` not an invented forecast when critical inputs are absent.

Create an index heatmap/cockpit with per-index UP/DOWN/FLAT, directional probability, expected points, uncertainty, regime, model version, timestamp and last realized score, separating tradable options from research-only indices.

Generate actionable option cards displaying current contract, strike/expiry, CE/PE, price band, SL/TP, modeled risk-reward and **net** expected value, available quantity, confidence evidence and next-update expiry; show real-time paper P&L for approved/autonomous variants.

Property-test calibrated probabilities sum to 1, all candidate contracts exist in the effective-dated instrument master, and no paper order can refer to an unlisted/expired/zero-depth option.

Exercise two simultaneous index forecasts with shared exposure, partial entry/exit fills, duplicate tick batches, reconnect, feed lag, exchange halt, expired quotes and overnight gap: no double trade, no early success, correct bounded capital and reconciled P&L.

Complete a real-session *paper-only* rehearsal with six derivative indices plus any research-only index subset, timestamped 15m signals, monitored exits, observed quote-backed paper fills and auditable separate forecast/portfolio scorecards.
